The real issue with `render_referrences` is the missing `get` with default:

```
def render_referrences(self, state: BlockState) -> Iterable[str]:
    ref_links = state.env.get('ref_links', {})
    for key in ref_links:
        attrs = ref_links[key]
        text = '[' + attrs['label'] + ']: ' + attrs['url']
        title = attrs.get('title')
        if title:
            text += ' "' + title + '"'
        yield text

def block_quote(self, token: Dict[str, Any], state: BlockState) -> str:
    text = indent(self.render_children(token, state), '> ', lambda _: True)
    text = text.rstrip("> \n")
    return text + '\n\n'
```
